Times are milliseconds relative to the harness action (Ctrl-C written to the pty, or SIGTERM sent), on the same clock as strace -ttt. Roles: `gmake@top` is the top-level make, `gmake@a` a level-1 make, `gmake@a/1` a leaf make; `@dir` after a recipe names the make that ran it. strace slows every process, so absolute gaps are longer than without tracing; the order of events within one process is exact, across processes it is the order in which strace observed them. A call that blocked is placed at the time it returned.
